newsitem.title: USA: CME lumber tumbles on fund selling, weak cash.
newsitem.headline: CME lumber tumbles on fund selling, weak cash.

text.p: Active fund selling, thought to be further long liquidation, added to pressure from a weak cash market and knocked CME March lumber futures down for a $10.00 per thousand board foot limit loss, traders said.
March was off the daily allowable $10.00 limit at $401.80 per tbf with other months off $6.50 to up $1.20 at 1155 CST.

Reports that more wholesalers were offering spruce at $390 per tbf, well under mill asking levels, prompted renewed pressure in futures. Prices had recovered from early lows on short covering but follow-through demand was lacking. Funds liquidated on the break, traders said.
